title: MMCA International Researcher Residency Program 2027
description: A curatorial/research residency at the National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA), supporting sustained research and professional exchange focused on modern and contemporary Asian art. Open to curators and researchers of any nationality except Korean citizens, with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience and fluency in English required; applicants who have previously participated in MMCA's Changdong or Goyang residency programs are not eligible. The 2027 program runs across three terms (April 1-June 10; July 1-September 9; September 30-December 9, 2027), with a total of 4 researchers selected across all terms. MMCA provides a private studio and accommodation free of charge, plus a monthly research grant of approximately KRW 1,200,000 (about USD 850); researchers are responsible for their own round-trip airfare, meals, local transportation, and research materials. Applications are accepted online via mmca.go.kr during a two-week window, September 7-18, 2026.
org: National Museum of Modern and Contemporary Art, Korea (MMCA)
visaNote: This is a research/curatorial residency, not employment; non-Korean researchers should confirm South Korea's short-stay/researcher visa requirements ahead of the residency.
